verdict.rationale: Zapier ships an official SDK, @zapier/zapier-sdk, installed via npm with OAuth or client-credentials auth for executing actions across 9,000+ apps. It is documented with a quickstart, a companion SDK CLI, and a typed Node module form, and a separate Platform CLI exists for building integrations in Node.js. Missing for 10: SDKs beyond Node/TypeScript (no Python or other languages evidenced), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s).
